fields.description: Attach one .xlsx or .csv file per DocType. Row 1 must hold the column headers. Leave 'Target DocType' empty to let it be detected automatically. Tip: use Download Template in the toolbar to get a ready-to-fill file.
fields.label: Data Files

fields.description: Rows skipped because they already exist, or (in Update mode) because no matching record was found.
fields.label: Skipped Rows

fields.description: Records deleted by the last rollback.
fields.label: Rolled Back Records

fields.description: Excel log of every failed and skipped row with the exact reason.
fields.label: Download Import Log (.xlsx)

fields.description: List of every record this import created (DocType + ID). Used by Rollback Import to undo the run.
fields.label: Rollback Manifest (.csv)

fields.description: The exact reason for each problem row. Use View Errors in the toolbar for a grouped summary, or download the Import Log for the complete list.
fields.label: Row Errors

fields.description: Calculated automatically: tier 0 is imported first, then tier 1, and so on.
fields.label: Calculated Tiers

fields.description: Rows per database commit. Minimum 500. Lower it if your rows trigger heavy server-side logic.
fields.label: Batch Chunk Size

fields.description: Insert = create new records only. Update = only touch records that already exist. Insert and Update = upsert. Existing records are matched by ID, then unique fields, then the title field.
fields.label: Import Mode
fields.options:
Insert New Records
Update Existing Records
Insert and Update

fields.description: Create records even when a linked record (Customer, Item, ...) does not exist yet.
fields.label: Ignore Missing Link Errors

fields.description: Create records even when mandatory fields are missing from the file.
fields.label: Ignore Missing Mandatory Fields

fields.description: Abort the whole import on the first failed row instead of continuing and logging it.
fields.label: Stop Immediately On First Error

fields.description: Skip rows whose record already exists instead of failing them. Recommended when re-running an import.
fields.label: Skip Rows That Already Exist

fields.description: Guess the target DocType from headers, sheet name and file name. A DocType you pick manually is never overwritten.
fields.label: Auto-Detect DocType Schema

fields.description: When an uploaded Excel file has more than one sheet, automatically add one row per extra sheet so every sheet gets imported. Turn off if you want to import only the sheet(s) you list yourself under Data Files.
fields.label: Auto-Add Rows For Extra Sheets

fields.description:
Optional. Map stubborn column headers to fieldnames and set default values per DocType:
{"Customer": {"column_map": {"Cust Name": "customer_name"}, "defaults": {"customer_type": "Company"}}}
Use Preview & Column Mapping to generate this automatically.
fields.label: Column Mapping & Defaults (JSON)
